astra_final_memory.summary: Attempt ended without completion after losing the pot. Right-only support apparently lifted it approximately 8 cm (47–48), but left fingers were fully closed at the empty 4.9 cm separation. Further upward plans failed (49); moving upward and backward lost right capture and the pot disappeared (50). Opening and withdrawing both arms did not reveal it after settling (51). A fresh attempt should verify settled bilateral capture before lifting and avoid treating unilateral suspension as a secure two-arm grasp.
